units.source_text: 七段以前曾到过这家堂岛旅馆，觉得是个对局的绝好地方，也就指定这里了。

en.t: The seventh-dan player had stayed at this Dojima inn before, thought it was an excellent place for a match, and so designated it as the venue.

units.source_text: 没想到赶巧下大雨，小溪流水量增加，溪流声很大，简直要把岩石冲走似的。

en.t: Unexpectedly, it happened to rain heavily; the brook swelled, and the roar of the current was so loud it seemed almost ready to sweep the rocks away.

units.source_text: 像这种建立在早川中央的旅馆，确实令人难以成眠。

en.t: An inn built like this in the middle of the Hayakawa River certainly made it hard to fall asleep.

units.source_text: 可能是七段自己感到有责任，才向名人致歉的吧。

en.t: Perhaps the seventh-dan player felt personally responsible, and that was why he apologized to the Master.
